subject: [hw] V41 -> IP: plain encode() (fds=0 in the runner) validates the real vendor stream; only wait_done remains daemon-side
body:
Auto-share proof on the real vendor stack, not just the unit test: with a /tmp-only edit of IV's runner that forces the plain n2ap_venc_encode() path (no encode_fd, no explicit shares), the full vendor session still validates:

  N2VHOST ion shares frame(fd=0x500)=0 bs(fd=0x501)=0   (the runner's explicit registration, unused by this run)
  N2VHOST encode seq-hdr bytes=29 key=0
  N2VHOST encode frame fds=0 bytes=115812 key=1
  N2VHOST bitstream .../bitstream-320x240.h264 115841 bytes
  run_vhost.sh: validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)

So daemon/vcodecd.c's current `n2ap_venc_encode(...)` call now passes usable input_fd/bs_fd to the vendor ring (the AP publishes them as 0x520/0x521 on first use, reuses them per handle). The remaining daemon-side item is only the `n2ap_venc_wait_done()` call after an async frame; with fds fixed, the frame reaches the hardware but res.bytes is 0 at the ACK, and vcodecd.c line ~836 rejects it.

No V41 action left for the first phone encode from my side.
